pages.title: Metamaterial Substrate
pages.text: The blank on which every circuit board is built: a neutronium base laced with quantum dots that tune its electrical and optical response. It is flat, faintly iridescent and heavier than it looks. Every board I make starts here.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Circuits need a stable base. In the Casimir Vacuum Press, I pressed Quantum Dots into a Neutronium Plate, giving a substrate whose response I could tune to any circuit.

Made in $(item)Casimir Vacuum Press$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Circuit Board, Dimensional Residue, Photonic Circuit Board, Topological Circuit Board.
